messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: P0 — Autoscaler stalled in aws-eu-south-1 due to GPU capacity limit being hit. Autoscaler is reporting 'InstanceLimitExceeded' and queue for g-serving has grown 3.1x in 6m.
sean: I’m on it. Looking at autoscaler logs now.
maya: Paging infra and prod oncall. Is there a fallback pool we can push traffic to?
praveen: autoscaler error excerpt: `ScalingActivity Failed  MaxCapacityForAZExceeded: Could not fulfill requested GPU instances in eu-south-1a` — looks like account-level instance limit, not AZ outage.
sean: Confirmed: AWS API `RequestLimitExceeded` when trying to launch p4d/p3. We have a per-account GPU hard cap. Pool autoscaler is stuck waiting for capacity.
infra-bot: Recent capacity events: aws-eu-south-1 reported 85% GPU utilization across accounts. No systemic EC2 outage.
olivia: Can we route lower-priority traffic to eu-west-1 temporarily? That's closest and has spare capacity.
sean: Yes — proposing immediate route change: move non-enterprise traffic to eu-west-1, keep enterprise customers pinned to dedicated pools (risk: slightly higher latency).
cs-jordan: Heads up — two paying customers reported slowdowns on model endpoints; tickets #8271 and #8274 opened. Not yet escalated to SLO impact but CPU-backed fallbacks are increasing latency.
praveen: Quick mitigation options: 1) fail open to CPU nodes for low-priority queues, 2) reduce batch sizes and concurrency to conserve GPUs, 3) spin up instances in a secondary account (requires creds + manual AMI bake).
sean: Implementing (2) now: reducing default batch size from 8 -> 4 and lowering concurrency. Pushing config via rollout: `sh deploy/rollout.sh --service g-serving --patch '{"batch_size":4,"max_concurrency":2}'`.
sean: Patch applied to canary. Monitoring qlen.
maya: Opening AWS quota request ticket with cloudops for burst increase (support case 123456789). ETA from AWS support is unknown — could be hours.
englead-ryan: Also start preparing a customer-facing status note. CS and Ops coordinate on message. If we end up routing to eu-west-1, include guidance about expected latency delta.
cs-jordan: Draft: "We are investigating capacity-related scaling issues in eu-south-1 affecting a subset of model endpoints. We are routing non-critical workloads to alternative regions and applying temporary throttles to reduce queueing. No data loss; some requests may see increased latency." ok?
olivia: LGTM, add note about teams we contacted for quota increase and expected next update in 30m.
praveen: Monitoring metrics: queue length dropped 28% in 7m after batch size change, but autoscaler still in pending due to API rejections. CPU fallback increase by 12%.
sean: Proceeding with (1) fail-open to CPU for user-level routes older than 30s in queue. Applying immediate policy rule: `route_policy: {fallback: cpu, max_queue_time: 30s}`
sean: Policy pushed. Observing tail latency for enterprise endpoints; holding stable so far.
infra-bot: Action logged: manual routing change applied by sean at 3123456854.
maya: Can someone request emergency capacity from partner account? We have a pre-approved partner account that has spare GPUs but requires a manual cross-account subnet change.
praveen: I can coordinate, but need approval from englead-ryan to use partner account. ETA to be ready ~18-25m.
englead-ryan: Approved. praveen take it.
praveen: Starting cross-account prep. Will copy AMIs and spin in eu-west-1 as hot standby, then re-route.
cs-jordan: Sending short alert to customers now. Notifying those with latency-sensitive SLAs that we're routing non-critical workloads and monitoring enterprise endpoints closely.
sean: Handoff: I'm leaving oncall in 20m. maya, you'll be taking principal pager. I'll leave a runbook snippet in the incident doc: `if queue growth > 2x for 15m and autoscaler errors persist, escalate to partner account and route non-critical to eu-west-1`.
maya: Ack. I'll keep watch and update status at +30m or on major change. tagging @everyone who needs to know :eyes:
incidents-bot: Incident updated: status => mitigated, actions applied: batch-size-reduced, cpu-fallback-enabled, partner-account-init. Next update scheduled in 30m.
cs-jordan: Closing loop with customers: initial messages sent. Will follow up after partner capacity comes online.
sean: Leaving detailed logs in thread and handover to maya. key logs: `autoscaler.log` lines showing `InstanceLimitExceeded` and `RequestLimitExceeded`.
maya: Thanks team. continuing watch. If autoscaler recovers or partner pool online I'll post immediate update.
olivia: Nice quick mitigation. Recommend follow-up item: request permanent quota increase and improve autoscaler fallback to multi-account routing in runbook.
praveen: Filed follow-up ticket in infra backlog: INFRA-1122 (permanent quota increase + multi-account routing support).
englead-ryan: Good work. We'll debrief tomorrow in incident review.
